data.title: Pelagos
data.about:
Pelagos by Invest Group Overseas (IGO) is a new residential tower in the highly sought-after Dubai Marina. Standing 35 floors tall, the building offers studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, all featuring fully fitted Smeg kitchens and premium Toto sanitary ware. The building will undergo full renovation and refurbishment, ensuring modern and luxurious living spaces for residents.

Situated in a prime location, Pelagos is just a short walk from DMCC and Sobha Realty metro stations, providing convenient access to Downtown Dubai and other key areas. The development is surrounded by restaurants, shopping malls, and beaches, making it an attractive choice for residents and investors. The high demand for rentals, combined with Dubai Marina's prestige and developed infrastructure, ensures strong investment potential. Major shopping centers and airports are also within proximity.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: It is in Dubai Marina, one of the most prestigious and sought-after neighborhoods, ideal for real estate investment.
  • Luxurious Amenities: This hotel offers high-end facilities, including a pool with marina views, fitness centers, yoga studios, and a 24/7 concierge service.
  • Proximity to Key Areas: Close to major business hubs like Downtown Dubai, as well as top tourist destinations, shopping malls, and beaches.
  • Modern Design: Apartments have high-quality finishes, including fully fitted Smeg kitchens and Toto sanitary ware.
  • Transport Access: Walking distance to metro stations (DMCC and Sobha Realty) and easy access to main highways.
  • Family-Friendly Environment: Surrounded by international schools, universities, and parks, it is ideal for families.
  • Future Growth Potential: The area’s infrastructure and continuous development enhance its long-term value for investors.

location_tile.title: An Address at the Heart of Exclusive Waterfront Living
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Living at Pelagos places you in the heart of Dubai Marina, one of the city’s most sought-after neighborhoods. Dubai Marina offers a vibrant urban lifestyle, combining modern conveniences with luxurious amenities. With excellent accessibility, residents enjoy easy access to major roads and public transport. This prime location ensures you're always close to essential services, entertainment, and everything Dubai offers. It’s the perfect blend of city life and comfort, making it ideal for property investment.

3 mins to JBR Beach 
6 mins to Palm Jumeirah 
7 mins to Bluewaters Island 
10 mins to Mall of the Emirates 
15 mins to Downtown Dubai
20 mins to Burj Khalifa 
25 mins to Dubai International Airport (DXB) 
30 mins to DMCC
35 mins to Al Maktoum International Airport

seo.metaTitle: Pelagos AT Dubai Marina by Invest Group Overseas (IGO)
seo.metaDescription: Pelagos by IGO offers luxury studios and 1-2 BR apartments in Dubai Marina, featuring modern amenities and a prime location near crucial attractions.

more_info.answer: Pelagos is scheduled for handover in Q1 2026, and 50% of the payment is due after the handover, making it a flexible investment opportunity.
more_info.question: When will Pelagos be completed?

more_info.answer: Pelagos offers a variety of units, including studios (389 - 460 sq. ft.), 1-bedroom (630 - 830 sq. ft.), and 2-bedroom apartments (1500 - 1600 sq. ft.).
more_info.question: What types of units are available in Pelagos?

more_info.answer: Residents at Pelagos enjoy underground parking, private beach access, a spa and wellness center, a state-of-the-art gym, an infinity pool, and 24/7 concierge services.
more_info.question: What are the key amenities provided at Pelagos?

more_info.answer: Yes, Pelagos offers high capital appreciation and is located in Dubai Marina, one of the most prestigious neighborhoods in Dubai.
more_info.question: Is Pelagos a good investment option?

more_info.answer: Pelagos is well connected to key locations, such as 3 minutes to JBR Beach, 10 minutes to Mall of the Emirates, and 25 minutes to Dubai International Airport.
